senses.gloss:
Yantṛ in the Rigveda^1 and in the Sūtras^2 denotes a ‘driver’
of horses or ‘charioteer.’
1) i. 162, 19; x. 22, 5.
2) Kātyāyana Śrauta Sūtra, xv. 6, 29, etc.

Yāna denotes ‘vehicle’ in the Rigveda^1 and later.^2
1) iv. 43, 6.
2) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, v. 5, 3, 7;
Ṣaḍviṃśa Brāhmaṇa, vi. 3, 10; Chān-
dogya Upaniṣad, viii. 12, 3, etc.
